name: Grano de Video
mechanism:
This method analyzes video grain (film grain / sensor noise) for forensic detection:

1. **Grain Patrón Extracción**: The fine-grained noise/grain pattern is extracted by separating the high-frequency stochastic component from image structure using adaptive filtering. The grain's spatial and statistical characteristics are measured.

2. **Grain Model Análisis**: The grain model (size, intensity, spatial frequency content, color characteristics) is identified. Camera sensor noise has specific properties: (a) Gaussian-Poisson distribution, (b) sensor-dependent spatial correlation, (c) color-dependent characteristics (more noise in blue channel). The method checks if the grain follows a physical sensor noise model.

3. **Grain Espacial Homogeneity**: Camera grain should be spatially homogeneous (uniform sensor produces uniform noise). The method checks grain homogeneity across the frame — different grain characteristics in the face vs. background indicate compositing of content from different sources.

4. **Grain Temporal Behavior**: Camera grain is temporally random (uncorrelated between frames) and should renew completely each frame. The method checks temporal grain independence. AI-generated grain may show temporal correlations — persistent grain patterns across frames or correlated grain changes.

5. **Grain - Señal Interaction**: Real camera grain is multiplicative (signal-dependent) — brighter regions show more shot noise. The method checks grain-signal dependency. AI generators often add additive noise (signal-independent) or no noise at all, producing an unrealistic grain-signal relationship detectable as a forensic indicator.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: sensor
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante video grain analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Verdoliva, L. (2020). Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview. IEEE JSTSP.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
